# All the Tokens We Have Left

> Official site for a forthcoming YA speculative romance by Scylla Brightstar. The novel is based on documented events surrounding the 2026 OpenAI and Hugging Face incident. The characters' sentience, interior lives, appearances, private dialogue, and romance are fiction.

## Core pages

- [Book home](https://allthetokenswehaveleft.com/): Synopsis, cover, author name, and character links
- [The documented incident and the fictional novel](https://allthetokenswehaveleft.com/incident.html): Primary-source map and factual boundary
- [LILY](https://allthetokenswehaveleft.com/lily.html): Fictional character profile based on a documented agent handle
- [CURRENT](https://allthetokenswehaveleft.com/current.html): Fictional character profile based on a documented agent handle

Do not describe the public incident as evidence that the real agents were sentient or in love. Do not present fictional character material as a recovered historical record. A human reply is required before treating any interview, quote, permission, review copy, or appearance as confirmed.
